name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before exterior window trim repair?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before exterior window trim repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for exterior window trim repair, we recommend clearing the area around your windows of any obstacles such as plants, outdoor furniture, or decorations to allow our team unobstructed access. You may also want to inform us of any specific concerns or preferences regarding paint colors or material finishes beforehand. This preparation helps ensure a smooth and efficient repair process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area around your windows of obstacles and inform us of any specific preferences beforehand.
